The fresh read shows this board drawing the one-block version instead — 38 texts, none of them a filter chip or a form Select. The nearest existing source to clone from is the populated Forms board 640:3135, whose own chip row could be cloned in. Separately and already done: the PRODUCT half of F11 shipped this session — FormsScreen now offers Retry on a failed load, with a test that asserts the screen recovers rather than that a handler fired.
